entries.good_example: check_resources() { local mem_threshold=90; local cpu_threshold=80; # Logic using /proc/stat for non-forking checks preferred; }
entries.rationale: Frequent calling of external binaries like 'free' or 'top' in a loop causes process overhead. SS QLM encourages reading directly from /proc/meminfo or /proc/loadavg for high-frequency auditing without spawning subshells.

entries.good_example: required_kb=$(du -s /data | awk '{print $1}'); available_kb=$(df --output=avail / | tail -1); [[ $available_kb -gt $required_kb ]] || { echo 'Insufficient space'; exit 1; }; tar ...
entries.rationale: Massive file operations should never start without calculating the required vs available space. SS QLM mandates a 'Space-Check-First' pattern to prevent filesystem lockups.
